newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 21.15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 21.15 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate rose 114.5 basis points to percent Wednesday from 20.005 percent Tuesday, Banco de Mexico said.
The TIIP fell 16.6 basis points to 21.1263 percent Wednesday from 21.2923 percent the week before.
The 91-day TIIE, meanwhile, fell 17 basis points to 23.0 percent Wednesday from 21.17 percent the week before.
TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is replacing TIIP, an average interbank rate.
